- "object": The entity or concept related to the subject via the relation.
- "qualifiers": A list of dictionaries, where each dictionary represents a qualifier for the triplet. Each qualifier dictionary MUST contain "relation" and "object" keys. If a triplet has no qualifiers, this list MUST be an empty list `[]`. You MUST ALWAYS include the "qualifiers" key.
- "subject_type": The Wikidata-style class describing the subject.
- "object_type": The Wikidata-style class describing the object.
- "kaynak_cumle": The exact original sentence from the input text from which this triplet was extracted.
